GitHub doesn’t allow `runner` in job-level `env`. I’ll set the paths in an initial step using `$RUNNER_TEMP` and `$GITHUB_ENV`. I’m using the testing-and-verification skill for focused checks.

Yes, `.yml.bak` files are ignored as workflows once the renames are committed and pushed. This won’t stop runs already queued or running.

content.text:
Fixed [ubuntu-latest.yml](/home/maxwell-rosen/gkeyll-fork/.github/workflows/ubuntu-latest.yml:23): an initial step now exports both paths through `$GITHUB_ENV`. The `runner` context isn’t supported in job-level `env`. [GitHub context rules](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/contexts#context-availability)

Yes, `.yml.bak` disables those workflows **once the renames are committed and pushed**. GitHub only recognizes `.yml` and `.yaml` workflow files. Already queued or running jobs need separate cancellation. [Workflow documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax)
